firstPlayerRule: Everyone begins together; whoever most recently watched a cartoon takes the first Market turn.
houseFallback: If the cartoon-watching comparison is unclear or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose the first Market player randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Give that player the first player card during setup. The opening Flip and Check Fame phases are simultaneous.
The Market phase then proceeds clockwise from the card holder. Each player may take up to two Hire or Dismiss actions.
If another round follows, pass the first player card clockwise during Cleanup. The card is not used in solo play.

internalEvidence: Complete publisher-hosted or publisher-linked PDF retrieved; relevant setup, opening-turn, variant and edition pages read and visually inspected. Reviewed PDF pages: 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11, 15, 16. Setup step 7 selects the latest cartoon viewer for the first player card. Rendered pages 6–7 explicitly make Flip and Check Fame simultaneous; page 8 starts individual clockwise Market turns with the card holder. Cleanup rotates the card only when another round follows. The repeated Final Flip tie-break concerns the eventual winner, not the initial card holder. Solo Setup removes the card entirely. The copyright is ©2025. Publisher discovery URL: https://thunderworksgames.com/products/fliptoons-game. Local source SHA-256: 4eb194ddfa83539c0de562bb52f52c3f00072ace2fc218aa9d0ca95c1eca56f2. Editorial review 2026-09-23: Codex checked the listed rendered PDF pages, publisher provenance, identity and edition, initial action versus setup, relevant mode context and tie-break scope. Owner authorization: Reload localhost, 2026-09-22. Random-mix decision: exclude. This criterion selects priority in a later Market phase after a simultaneous opening, rather than a first actor at the start of play. Preserve that distinction in the directory; do not adapt it into a different random-mix rule.
uncertainty: The source gives no tie-break for assigning the initial first player card.
This answer covers the identified publisher file; other editions may differ.
